body: Part of e553ce, after the macOS port and the Android trial. A second backend behind the same trait: xcrun simctl list/boot/install/launch/terminate and io screenshot; taps, swipes, text and buttons through idb (simctl has no tap). Coordinates in points vs pixels: map through the capture scale. Fake simctl/idb scripts for tests.
title: screen 9: iOS simulator backend (simctl + idb)
